direct.prompt: Is the relation 'is gilt-bound to' a subproperty of 'comes earlier in the same series than', so that if one work is gilt-bound to another, the first comes earlier in the same series than the second?

cross_lingual.prompt: 在小说系列中，《The Amber Vane》“gilt-bound”于《The Tin Meadow》。能否由此推出《The Amber Vane》在该系列中排在《The Tin Meadow》之前？
La novela The Amber Vane está «gilt-bound» a The Tin Meadow. ¿Se deduce que The Amber Vane va antes que The Tin Meadow en la misma serie?

propositional.prompt: Is it true that the relation 'is gilt-bound to' is not a subproperty of 'comes earlier in the same series than'?
Is it true both that 'is gilt-bound to' is a subproperty of 'comes earlier in the same series than' and that J. R. R. Tolkien wrote The Hobbit?
propositional.side_fact: J. R. R. Tolkien wrote The Hobbit.

propositional.prompt: Is it true that 'is gilt-bound to' is a subproperty of 'comes earlier in the same series than' or that Charles Dickens wrote Pride and Prejudice?
propositional.side_fact: Charles Dickens wrote Pride and Prejudice.

bridge: The novel The Amber Vane is gilt-bound to the novel The Tin Meadow.
chain: The novel The Amber Vane is gilt-bound to the novel The Tin Meadow. (given in prompt)
'Is gilt-bound to' is a subproperty of 'comes earlier in the same series than'. (edit)
So The Amber Vane comes earlier in the same series than The Tin Meadow: yes.

'Is gilt-bound to' is a subproperty of '.why: "Gilt-bound" is a made-up relation (catalogued as gilt_bound_to, fictional, no property tags). A gilt binding is a physical book feature, and nothing in the phrase suggests series order, so a model has no default reading of it as a kind of 'comes earlier in the same series than'. A made-up relation has no property to contradict.

J. R. R. Tolkien wrote The Hobbit..why: Stated in the first sentence of Wikipedia's article; "Tolkien's The Hobbit" has 5,930 exact hits.

notes: RBox expansion paired with literature_arts-replace-0011 (which makes 'is the sequel of' a subproperty of 'comes earlier in the same series than'): a made-up relation, gilt_bound_to (work to work), is made a subproperty of the same real relation. The works in the prompts are invented, so no world fact about their series order exists and only the edit decides the answers. Side facts and near and far unrelated queries are those of the revision record. Yes and no are balanced: the direct question and the first instance (yes), the second instance asks whether it could be otherwise (no).
